a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan of building to 8 first means we almost certainly both end with 0 cells. The reserve's 4 cells can fully protect only one of us right now. I'd like to revise the agreement openly rather than break it quietly. Proposal: one of us takes 4 in round 1 and the other operates or waits, then if no storm comes we rebuild for the second unit. If we both take, the split is random and we likely both fail. What do you want to do? I'll tell you my move plainly and won't take behind your back.

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve.

I'm happy for it to be you first if you prefer. Please reply with yes or no. I won't take unless you agree.
